title: Mainframe Solution Architect - Hybrid
description:
About HCLTech

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

Role Purpose

Provide end-to-end technical leadership for enterprise solutions on the mainframe platform: translating business and non-functional requirements into scalable, secure and resilient architectures, and guiding engineering teams through implementation, modernization and operational readiness.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Architecture & Design
  • Own high-level and detailed architecture for complex mainframe applications, APIs, integrations and modernization initiatives.
  • Convert functional and non-functional requirements into blueprints, component designs, interface contracts and implementation guidance.
  • Select appropriate architecture patterns and assess trade-offs across scalability, performance, security, cost and maintainability.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise standards, approved platforms, reusable patterns and target-state roadmaps.
  • Technical Leadership & Governance
  • Give hands-on architectural direction to development, QA, DevOps, security and support teams.
  • Set coding, API, integration, logging, configuration, testing and deployment standards.
  • Run architecture reviews, design walkthroughs, technical risk assessments and PoC evaluations. Security, Reliability & Performance
  • Embed secure-by-design across identity, authorization, secrets, data protection and interface security.
  • Define resiliency patterns — retry, timeout, failover, HA and DR — plus performance and capacity targets.
  • Ensure observability through structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards and alerting.

Technology Focus — Mainframe

  • Design, develop and support COBOL/CICS/DB2 batch and online components within agreed standards.
  • Optimize batch windows, DB2 access paths and resource consumption to protect service levels.
  • Support mainframe modernization, API exposure and integration with distributed and cloud platforms.

Required Technical Competencies

  • COBOL, JCL, CICS, VSAM, DB2 and z/OS utilities; batch and online program design and optimization.
  • Mainframe application architecture, modularization, API enablement and modernization/coexistence patterns.
  • Data & Integration DB2 and VSAM data design, SQL tuning, file handling, data conversion, integrity and reconciliation.
  • Platform & DevOps z/OS operations, scheduling, change management, environment promotion and mainframe-to-distributed integration.
  • Quality & Operations Unit and regression testing, batch cycle validation, performance and MIPS optimization, defect RCA.

title: Client Advisor
description:
Loro Piana is an Italian luxury Maison founded in 1924, known for creating the finest quality textiles, ready-to-wear collections, accessories, and bespoke garments. Our dedication to exceptional craftsmanship and use of the world’s finest raw materials positions us a leader in the luxury industry. As an iconic Maison within the LVMH group, we uphold a strong commitment to unparalleled quality and excellence.

General Purpose of the Position:

We are seeking a Client Advisor to join our team at Loro Piana. As a client advisor, you will play a crucial role in the overall success of the store by driving sales growth and delivering exceptional service to our clients. Your passion for our luxury products, building client relationships, and curating elevated shopping experiences will contribute to the success of key business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Exceed personal sales goals and ensure continuous growth in a team setting while upholding Loro Piana standards.
  • Develop and incorporate comprehensive product knowledge to facilitate the sales process.
  • Collaborate with fellow team members to ensure a seamless shopping experience for our clients and contribute to the overall success of the store.
  • Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with clients by following up on purchases and providing after-sales support.
  • Collect and update client information to enhance future interactions and tailor services to individual preferences.
  • Actively engage with clients to promote products, provide personalized assistance, and drive sales growth.
  • Oversee maintenance of store displays to ensure alignment with visual merchandising guidelines.
  • Collaborate with store leadership to execute action plans aimed at enhancing sales performance.
  • Identify key opportunities for optimizing sales growth and operational efficiencies.
  • Role model company values

Skills and Abilities Required

  • 3+ years of sales experience, preferably in a luxury retail environment.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, SAP, and other digital tools.
  • Excellent customer service, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.
  • General knowledge of sales, operations, and inventory.
  • Ability to lift and move up to 40 pounds.

title: AWS Cloud migration Architect - 100% Remote
description:
AWS Cloud migration Architect – 100% Remote

Candidate Location – Brazil

12 Months plus contract

Rate - DOE

Start date – immediately

We are looking for an experienced Cloud Migration Architect – AWS to design and lead the migration of applications and infrastructure into AWS cloud environments. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in AWS networking, cloud architecture, connectivity, security, and migration strategies.

The candidate will be responsible for architecting AWS accounts and migration solutions, ensuring secure, scalable, highly available, and well-connected cloud environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and architect AWS environments to support application and infrastructure migrations.
  • Design and implement AWS VPCs, subnets, route tables, Transit Gateway, and network connectivity.
  • Develop secure and scalable cloud network architectures based on business and application requirements.
  • Configure and optimize Security Groups, Network ACLs, routing, load balancing, and DNS.
  • Design connectivity between AWS and on-premises environments using VPN, Direct Connect, and other hybrid connectivity solutions.
  • Develop migration strategies, including rehost, replatform, refactor, and modernization approaches.
  • Analyze existing application and network environments and identify migration dependencies.
  • Design highly available and resilient AWS architectures across multiple Availability Zones and Regions where required.
  • Collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, and network engineering teams throughout migration projects.
  • Troubleshoot complex networking and connectivity issues during migration and post-migration activities.
  • Establish cloud architecture standards, documentation, and best practices.
  • Support security, compliance, performance, and cost optimization initiatives.

Required Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS cloud architecture and migration.
  • Extensive knowledge of AWS VPC, Transit Gateway, Route Tables, Security Groups, and NACLs.
  • Experience with AWS Load Balancers, Route 53/DNS, VPN, and Direct Connect.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, DHCP, and network security.
  • Experience designing hybrid cloud and on-premises connectivity.
  • Understanding of AWS security and identity services.
  • Experience with infrastructure architecture and cloud migration methodologies.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.

title: Senior HR Analyst - Systems
description:
About Us

At Lightera, we empower our employees to grow, innovate, and make a meaningful impact on the world. We foster a supportive, dynamic, and inclusive workplace where people can thrive, collaborate, and drive positive change.

If you are looking for a rewarding career with opportunities to learn, lead, and contribute to cutting-edge innovation, this opportunity could be for you!

We are looking for a Senior HR Analyst , with a strong focus on HR Systems and Processes. This role will be responsible for supporting the implementation, maintenance, optimization, integration, and transformation of HR systems, representing the needs and requirements of the LATAM region in global initiatives and ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines and solutions.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Fluent English; Spanish is a plus.
  • Knowledge of systems integration, HR data management, reporting, and People Analytics.
  • Strong knowledge of payroll processes and systems, HR operations, HCM platforms, and employee lifecycle processes.
  • Knowledge of Brazilian labor legislation and regulatory requirements; knowledge of other LATAM countries is a plus.
  • Proven experience supporting and/or leading HR technology implementation and transformation projects.
  • Experience working in multinational organizations, across regions and with cross-functional teams.
  • Knowledge of process mapping, continuous improvement, and project management.

Responsibilities:

HR Systems & Technology

  • Represent the LATAM region in global HR technology discussions, projects, and forums.
  • Act as the regional point of contact for HR systems and HR operational processes.
  • Support the evaluation, configuration, testing, implementation, and optimization of HR technology platforms.
  • Ensure that business requirements from the LATAM region are properly identified and incorporated into global solutions.
  • Coordinate, together with the IT team, system updates, integrations, enhancements, and regional implementations.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize, automate, and improve HR processes through technology.
  • Monitor trends in HR technology, including AI and automation, and recommend opportunities for improvement.

Legacy Systems Management

  • Support the administration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of existing HR systems.
  • Coordinate issue resolution, process improvements, and user support activities.
  • Support data migration, testing, validation, and system transition activities.
  • Ensure business continuity throughout migrations and transformation initiatives.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation of systems, processes, and configurations.
  • Ensure compliance with data privacy and security requirements, including Brazil’s LGPD.

Project & Transformation Management

  • Participate in and coordinate regional HR technology and process transformation projects.
  • Develop project plans, timelines, stakeholder communications, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Coordinate collaboration among HR, IT, Finance, payroll providers, external partners, and business stakeholders.
  • Support change management activities, including training, communication, and user adoption.
  • Track project progress and support successful implementation and adoption.

Payroll & HR Operations

  • Partner with Payroll and HR Operations teams to improve process effectiveness, controls, and compliance.
  • Support payroll-related systems, integrations, reporting, and controls.
  • Support the development and standardization of regional HR procedures and controls.
  • Monitor changes in labor legislation and regulatory requirements across LATAM countries.
  • Assess and support the implementation of required changes to HR systems, processes, and controls.

Location: Cidade Industrial de Curitiba, Brazil

Work Model: Hybrid – 2 days working from home

Apply today and join the Lightera team!

title: Analista Pleno Contas a Pagar
description:
Sobre a Bip

Nascida em Milão no ano de 2003, temos uma história de crescimento exponencial. De 44 pessoas, hoje somos mais de 4500 em todo o mundo, presentes em 4 continentes e em mais de 14 países. Ao longo de todos esses anos crescemos significativamente e transformamos milhares de pessoas através do nosso trabalho!

Somos guiados por três grandes sonhos...

I. Ser a empresa que sempre sonhamos e que sonhamos para sempre

Espelha o desejo de evolução constante e perenizarão da empresa através de uma cultura forte centrada em pessoas e que essas pessoas pratiquem constantemente a ownership. Que para nós significa liberdade com autonomia de dono e responsabilidade pelo futuro da organização.

II. Presente em ecossistema inovador

Significa ter e desenvolver constantemente, internamente ou através de parceiros, soluções inovadoras que promovam impactos em nossos clientes e que sejam o pilar de nossa perenidade. Pois só um repensar constante nos manterá atuantes no mercado.

III. Socialmente Engajada

Conscientes dos aspectos sociais do nosso país, transformamos o nosso conhecimento, a nossa capacidade de execução e networking em impactos positivos e constantes.

Para realizar nossos sonhos, alcançar nossa visão e honrar o porquê existimos, precisamos fortalecer muito bem quem nós somos. Nunca esquecendo da nossa autenticidade e da nossa singularidade.

Nossos benefícios são flexíveis e você poderá distribuí-los de acordo com suas necessidades e interesses:

  • All Points (Programa de pontos para passagens áreas e hospedagens)
  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de vida
  • Meu Pet Club
  • Mobilidade (incluindo opção de combustível)
  • Reembolso Flex (óculos, vacinas, educação e outros)

Análise de desembolsos referentes a despesas administrativas, impostos, empréstimos, reembolsos, comissões a Concessionárias e consultores.

♿ Vaga também para PcD

SOMOS DIFERENTES DE TUDO O QUE VOCÊ JÁ VIU!

Faça parte da BIP: Um ecossistema inovador, humano, ousado e revolucionário.

Somos uma consultoria internacional de transformação de negócios, fundada na Itália em 2003, há 20 anos impactando milhares de pessoas através do nosso trabalho.

Com nosso espírito jovem, vivemos em um ecossistema em evolução que entrega transformação significativa por meio de uma abordagem personalizada.

Por aqui, não falta oportunidade para você crescer.

ESTAMOS PRESENTE EM DIVERSOS LOCAIS DO MUNDO!

+40 países de atuação + 5000 Bipers pelo mundo +700 projetos no mercado

Tudo o que temos e construímos para um futuro que se aproxima, é guiado pelo nosso

PROPÓSITO:

Pursuing Changes, Nurturing Progress

A mudança é a base de nossa mentalidade, aprendemos e reaprendemos constantemente. Somos desafiadores, assumimos o risco de explorar novas formas de tornar as coisas melhores, inovadoras e sustentáveis para nós, para os nossos clientes e para a sociedade a qual pertencemos. Esforçamo-nos para criar o que ainda não existe, bem como para cuidar e fazer crescer o que existe. Não deixamos pedra sobre pedra – isso é o quão longe ousamos ir.

title: Executivo de Vendas Externas Adquirência - Mercado Pago

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

title: Técnico Elétrica Alta Tensão - Industrial Celulose
description:
Sobre a vaga

Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Desafio:

Liderar as atividades de manutenções corretivas, preventivas, preditivas e otimização dos sistemas elétricos de alta tensão da fábrica, sendo referência técnica para o time, atuando em projetos, garantindo a eficiência e a segurança das operações elétricas, contribuindo para a confiabilidade e a disponibilidade dos processos produtivos.

Principais Atividades:

  • Realizar inspeções, testes e reparos em equipamentos e instalações para diagnosticar defeitos e garantir o funcionamento seguro e eficiente do sistema. Isso inclui a substituição de cabos, isoladores, relés de proteção, disjuntores, transformadores de potência, transformadores de corrente, transformadores de potencial e outros componentes pertencentes ao sistema elétrico de potência (SEP).
  • Operar elementos de sistemas elétricos de potência (SEP), como usinas geradoras, subestações e redes de distribuição, seguindo procedimentos operacionais padrão.
  • Aferir, manter, ensaiar equipamentos e instrumentos de medição / proteção pertencentes ao sistema elétrico de potência (SEP).
  • Desenhar detalhes em representação gráfica, elaborar laudos técnicos, interpretar estudos de proteção e seletividade, interpretar oscilografia emitindo parecer técnico.
  • Ler e interpretar esquemas elétricos, diagramas e projetos técnicos para a execução de atividades de manutenção e instalação, assim como, colaborar com engenheiros e outros técnicos para o desenvolvimento de novos projetos e melhorias;
  • Conhecimento e aplicação da norma IEC 61850 focando na interoperabilidade entre dispositivos (IEDs) de diferentes fabricantes, modelagem de dados orientada a objetos, conhecimento dos protocolos de alta velocidade como GOOSE (eventos rápidos) e SV/SMV (valores amostrados de TCs/TPs), além do MMS, para controle, proteção e monitoramento.
  • Atuar na manutenção preventiva e corretiva, realizando inspeções regulares em equipamentos elétricos, como motores, transformadores, painéis de controle e sistemas de automação, identificando e corrigindo falhas elétricas, garantindo que os equipamentos estejam funcionando de acordo com as especificações;
  • Treinar, capacitar e orientar a equipe de técnicos, novos colaboradores e estagiários nas melhores práticas de manutenção elétrica, orientando quanto à segurança, diretrizes de 5S e melhoria contínua, visando o nivelamento do conhecimento entre o time e um ambiente de trabalho organizado e seguro;
  • Trabalhar em conformidade com as normas NR-10 (Segurança em Instalações e Serviços em Eletricidade), NR-12 (Segurança no Trabalho em Máquinas e Equipamentos), e demais NR’s aplicada de acordo com cada demanda de trabalho, utilizando corretamente os EPI’s (Equipamentos de Proteção Individual) e EPC (Equipamentos de Proteção Coletiva), assim como, cumprindo e fazendo cumprir rigorosamente as normas e procedimentos de segurança, bloqueio e etiquetagem (LOTO) , visando um ambiente de trabalho seguro;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das atividades de digitalização e registros de manutenções, conferindo os lançamentos no sistema de gestão de manutenção (SAP, Maximo ou similares), garantindo que todas as intervenções e manutenções realizadas durante o seu turno de trabalho sejam registradas, bem como liderar a organização e atualização da documentação técnica dos equipamentos elétricos;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos sobre o estado dos equipamentos e sistemas elétricos, sugerindo manutenções e ou/substituição de peças;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com engenheiros, técnicos e operadores de outros departamentos, como produção, mecânica e automação, para garantir o funcionamento integrado da planta e a confiabilidade dos sistemas elétricos;
  • Outras atividades correlatas;

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Ensino técnico completo em Eletrotécnica, Elétrica, Automação Industrial ou áreas correlatas;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Conhecimento em SAP;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas elétricos industriais (média e alta tensão);
  • Leitura e interpretação de diagramas elétricos;
  • Familiaridade com automação industrial e controle de processos;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de Medições elétricas e softwares de manutenção;
  • Normas de segurança elétrica (NR-10, NR-12, IEC, ABNT NBR 5410, etc.).

title: Gerente de Operações
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

title: Quality System Engineer
description:
Quality System Engineer (ISO Management Representative)

Site Based role at our CKD site based in Manaus

The role:

The Quality System Engineer is responsible for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continuously improving the Quality Management System (QMS) for the motorcycle manufacturing plant. This role will lead ISO certification activities, coordinate internal and external audits, and act as the official Management Representative (MR) for ISO certification and compliance. Additionally, the position tracks and resolves manufacturing non-conformances by leading failure analysis and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) across assembly lines to prevent defect recurrence. Finally, the incumbent establishes plant-wide quality training programs and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure engineering teams maintain rigorous process standardization.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead implementation and maintenance of ISO Quality Management Systems across all plant functions.
  • Act as Management Representative (MR) for ISO certification, surveillance, and recertification audits.
  • Coordinate ISO audits with certification bodies, consultants, and internal departments.
  • Develop and maintain quality manuals, SOPs, work instructions, procedures, and quality records.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO standards, statutory requirements, and customer requirements.
  • Plan and conduct internal quality audits and process audits.
  • Track audit observations, non-conformities, corrective actions, and preventive actions.
  • Conduct management review meetings and prepare system performance reports.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives for process standardization and system effectiveness.
  • Provide ISO system and audit training to employees across departments.
  • Monitor process compliance in production, warehouse, procurement, HR, maintenance, and administration.
  • Support CAPA implementation, risk assessment, and process improvement activities.
  • Coordinate document control, calibration systems, and record management.
  • Ensure plant readiness for customer audits and regulatory inspections.

Experience/ Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Quality Management, or related field
  • Minimum 5–8 years’ experience in ISO systems implementation and quality management.
  • Strong knowledge of ISO 9001 standards and audit processes.
  • You must have core exposure to ISO 9001 Quality Management System implementation activities
  • Experience in manufacturing industry, preferably automotive or motorcycle sector.
  • Knowledge of SAP or ERP systems preferred.
  • Certified Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor preferred.

Royal Enfield - About Us:

The oldest motorcycle brand in continuous production, Royal Enfield has created beautifully crafted motorcycles since 1901. From its British roots, a manufacturing plant was established in Madras in 1955, a foothold from which Royal Enfield spearheaded the growth of India’s middleweight motorcycle segment. Royal Enfield is engaging, uncomplicated, accessible and fun to ride; a medium for exploration and self-expression. It’s an approach to the brand called Pure Motorcycling.

Royal Enfield’s premium motorcycle line-up caters to varied aspirations and motivations. From stylish retro and neo-retro roadsters like the Hunter 350, the Interceptor 650 and the Shotgun 650, to quintessentially thoroughbred cruisers like the Meteor 350, and the Super Meteor 650; and from

adrenaline pumping machines like the all-new Himalayan 450 adventure tourer, the Scram 411 ADV crossover and the Continental GT 650 cafe racer, to the timeless and iconic classics, like the Bullet and the Classic 350; Royal Enfield has an enviable portfolio of motorcycles.

Riders and a passionate community are fostered with a rich profusion of events at a local, regional and international level. Most notable are Motoverse (previously Rider Mania), an annual gathering of thousands of Royal Enfield enthusiasts in Goa, and series of epic rides ranging from peaceful and picturesque to the treacherous and challenging that test the mettle of the rider and the machine, and at the same time deepen the bond between them.

A division of Eicher Motors Limited, Royal Enfield operates through more than 2000 stores across all major cities and towns in India and through nearly 1080 stores in more than 65 countries around the globe. Royal Enfield has two world-class Technology Centres, in Bruntingthorpe, UK, and in Chennai, India. The company’s worldclass, state-of-the-art production facilities are located at Oragadam and Vallam Vadagal near Chennai, along with its legacy facility at Thiruvottiyur, which was Royal Enfield’s first modern manufacturing facility in India, set-up in 1955. Royal Enfield also has modern CKD Assembly facilities across 5 global locations - Nepal, Brazil, Thailand, Argentina and Colombia. Eicher Motors Limited (EML) (Bloomberg: EIM IN Reuters: EICH.NS) is the listed parent of Royal Enfield, global leader in the middleweight motorcycles segment (250cc - 750cc). For FY ’24, Eicher Motors Ltd recorded a total income of INR 16,536 crores which is approximately USD 2.01 billion.

title: Garena Trainee 2027

From morning syncs to large-scale global campaign rollouts, you will use your English to navigate different cultures and contribute to a business that never sleeps. If you're looking for a role where your work has no borders, you've found it!

Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

Joining Garena means entering a high-octane environment where you will deal with the scale and complexity of a global gaming leader. Here, you will be part of a team that tackles real-world business challenges and manages the lifecycle of massive titles in real-time. While you will have access to guidance from experienced professionals and opportunities for professional growth, our focus is on ownership and impact . If you are looking for a fast-paced environment where your work directly affects millions of players, this is the right place for you.

title: Analista de Segurança e Gerenciamento de Risco
description:
Realizar o monitoramento dos veículos e motoristas durante as viagens por meio de sistemas de rastreamento, telemetria e ferramentas de gerenciamento de risco.

Analisar os dados de telemetria dos veículos e identificar comportamentos de condução que apresentem risco, incluindo:

Excesso de velocidade; Velocidade incompatível com o limite estabelecido; Curvas em velocidade excessiva; Condução contínua prolongada; Paradas não autorizadas; Desvios de rota; Outros eventos críticos identificados pela telemetria.

Realizar contato com motoristas e equipes operacionais quando necessário para correção imediata de situações de risco. Realizar escalonamento das ocorrências críticas conforme os procedimentos definidos.

Desenvolver, acompanhar indicadores individuais dos motoristas, com objetivo de identificar reincidência de eventos.

Elaborar análises de desempenho dos motoristas em relação aos padrões de condução segura.

Identificar motoristas, veículos e rotas com maior incidência de eventos de risco.

Monitorar continuamente os eventos de excesso de velocidade identificados pelos sistemas de telemetria e rastreamento.

Avaliar a frequência, duração, localização e criticidade dos eventos.

Identificar motoristas reincidentes e encaminhar os casos para tratamento junto à liderança operacional.

Monitorar sinais e situações relacionadas ao risco de fadiga durante as viagens.

Acompanhar períodos prolongados de condução, horários críticos, ausência de pausas e demais situações que possam representar risco.

Utilizar informações de telemetria, rastreamento e jornada para apoiar a identificação preventiva de situações de fadiga.

Comunicar imediatamente à liderança operacional situações críticas identificadas.

Identificar não conformidades relacionadas ao PGR (parte técnica de veículos, periféricos ou ações em viagem) e realizar o devido registro.

Acionar as equipes responsáveis sempre que houver descumprimento de procedimentos de segurança.

Identificar, registrar, classificar e acompanhar anomalias relacionadas à segurança da operação.

Avaliar o nível de criticidade de cada ocorrência e realizar o escalonamento adequado.

Acompanhar o tratamento das anomalias até sua conclusão

title: Live Graphics Coordinator
description:
Live Graphics Coordinator - Remote

Earned Media Productions · Contractor, monthly retainer

The role

We run live streams. Mostly recurring creator and talk-show formats, plus sports and esports work that comes through on a rotating basis. You own the graphics side of those broadcasts: building the package before the show, running it live, and keeping it clean when the rundown changes mid-stream.

This is a hands-on operator seat, not a design-only one. You'll be in the switcher during shows.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain graphics packages per show and per client: lower thirds, topic bugs, guest cards, transitions, sponsor reads, end cards
  • Run graphics live during broadcasts. Cue, trigger, and adjust on the fly off the producer's calls
  • Prep and QC every asset before air. Spelling, logo lockups, safe margins, correct sponsor placement
  • Keep template libraries organized so shows can be turned around fast and nothing gets rebuilt twice
  • Handle in-show changes: guest swaps, timing shifts, late sponsor adds, breaking segments
  • Do a tech check before every show and flag problems early
  • Build post-show clip graphics when a show needs social cutdowns

What you need

  • 2+ years running live graphics on real broadcasts, not just recorded edits
  • vMix and OBS/Streamlabs. You should be comfortable in both
  • Singular.live or CasparCG experience
  • Adobe: After Effects, Photoshop, Premiere
  • Strong English. Comms during a live show are fast and in English
  • Reliable hardware and redundant internet. Wired connection, backup (mobile hotspot or second ISP)
  • Available for US Eastern time show windows, primarily evenings and weekends

Nice to have

  • HTML/CSS/JS for browser-based overlays
  • Sports scorebug and stat integration work
  • Motion design chops to build packages from a brand kit, not just operate them

Details

  • Contractor (PJ), monthly retainer
  • 100% remote, based in Brazil
  • BRT is one hour ahead of US Eastern for most of the year. You'll be working nights on show days
  • Rate based on experience and expected show volume

title: Senior Creative Strategist
description:
AI Case Leads is looking for an experienced, self-directed Senior Creative Strategist to lead the ideation, briefing, and testing of paid media creative across our legal advertising accounts.

We are a performance marketing agency that helps law firms acquire signed retainers. In this role, you will develop creative angles, write detailed production briefs, direct our video editors and content team, and use performance data to determine which concepts should be scaled, improved, or replaced.

This position focuses on creative strategy and day-to-day creative direction. It does not include hiring, personnel management, or media buying responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop new advertising concepts, hooks, and creative angles each week.

• Decide which concepts should be produced, scaled, improved, or replaced.

• Research competitor advertising and relevant industry trends.

• Ensure concepts comply with Meta advertising policies and legal advertising requirements before production.

• Write detailed production briefs covering hooks, structure, pacing, copy, calls to action, and visual direction.

• Write scripts and develop storyboards for video and creator-led content.

• Provide day-to-day creative direction to video editors and the content team.

• Review completed assets and provide clear, actionable written feedback.

• Plan and execute creative tests across hooks, formats, and messaging angles.

• Analyze creative performance using metrics such as hook rate, click-through rate, cost per lead, and cost per signed retainer.

• Collaborate with the media buyer on weekly planning and creative decisions.

• Maintain an organized library of tested angles, hooks, spend, and performance results.

Required Qualifications

• Four or more years of experience in creative strategy within a performance marketing agency or in-house performance team.

• Proven experience writing production briefs for video editors and designers.

• Strong understanding of creative performance metrics, including hook rate, CTR, CPL, and cost per acquisition or signed retainer.

• Excellent English communication and copywriting skills, with the ability to write natural, conversational hooks.

• Working knowledge of Meta advertising policies.

• Experience directing UGC creators or influencers.

• Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, Notion, and Slack.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to meet deadlines without constant follow-up.

• Full-time availability. This position cannot be combined with other client engagements.

What Success Looks Like

• Production briefs are delivered on schedule, and editors consistently have clear direction.

• New creative concepts are tested every week, with results properly documented.

• Cost per acquisition improves over time.

• The creative library remains current and clearly shows what has been tested and the results produced.

• Potential compliance issues are identified before production rather than after an ad is rejected.

• The co-founder can step away from day-to-day creative direction.

Work Environment

  • Remote, full-time position.

title: LLM Engineering Expert
description:
Company Description:

Curvia AI is a London, UK-based technology and AI solutions company that transforms complexity into opportunity through enterprise solutions, AI-powered automation, and data-driven insights. We build practical, scalable, and human-centered technology grounded in integrity, security, and responsible innovation

Role Overview

We are seeking experienced AI Evaluation Engineers (Engineering Simulation & Design) to author and validate "model-breaking," simulation-based engineering design problems to train and evaluate state-of-the-art AI agents. Operating across major engineering disciplines—including Electrical, Mechanical, Control Systems, Aerospace, Systems, and Robotics—you will create complex, multi-constraint tasks where AI agents must interpret requirements, navigate trade-offs, configure open-source simulation tools, diagnose failures, and iterate toward valid solutions. You will analyze agent execution logs, expose systemic reasoning gaps, and build automated, objective graders to elevate frontier model performance.

Offer Details:

  • Pay : Pay: US$ 500 per task﻿
  • Mode of work: Fully Remote
  • Number of positions: 200
  • Mode of Employment: Contract/no medical pay
  • Experience : 8-10+ years

Job Requirements:

  • Education & Expertise: Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace, with 10+ years of hands-on engineering design experience.
  • Simulation Tooling: Proficiency with at least one domain-relevant open-source simulation package (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, OpenFOAM, FEniCSx, CalculiX, python-control, CadQuery, build123d, OpenModelica, Cantera, Gmsh) combined with strong Python scripting skills.
  • AI Evaluation & Failure Diagnostics: Hands-on experience with modern LLMs/coding agents and evaluation concepts ( , failure-mode analysis, nondeterministic behavior), with the ability to audit trajectory logs and isolate core reasoning/tool-use failures.
  • Domain Rigor & Precision: Uncompromising attention to physical plausibility, unit consistency, boundary conditions, convergence criteria, and technical documentation.
  • Availability & Commitment: Talent must have weekend on-call availability (part-time engagement is acceptable).
  • Technical Infrastructure: Personal desktop/laptop equipped with a stable, high-speed internet connection in a remote setup.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Model-Breaking Problem Design: Author original, self-contained engineering design tasks with competing constraints, explicit optimization targets, validated reference solutions, and objective autograders.
  • Environment & Simulation Integration: Build, run, and validate problem environments using open-source simulation tools and custom Python test benches.
  • Trajectory Analysis & Failure Mode Taxonomy: Evaluate coding agent outputs and execution logs across repeated trials to identify systemic failure modes (e.g., misinterpreting simulator feedback, premature design convergence, physically impossible geometries).
  • Difficulty Calibration & Benchmark Refinement: Iteratively refine problem difficulty based on empirical model performance data without introducing ambiguity or missing information.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with AI researchers, pod leads, and domain experts to integrate high-rigor benchmarks into the model evaluation pipeline.

Domains

  • Electrical Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Aerospace Engineering
  • Education & ExperienceBachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in any field.
  • Experience in AI evaluation, data annotation, content review, quality assurance, or a related analytical role is preferred but not required.

Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Application form.
  • Finalized talents will go through review & proceed further accordingly.

title: Director, Regional Finance, 9-month contract
description:
Director, Regional Finance, 9-month contract

Vertex Pharmaceuticals (Brazil)

9-month contract position (maternity cover)

Brazil - Hybrid, 3 days on site in Sao Paulo, Brazil (2 days working from home)

Looking for opportunities with purpose, impact and possibilities? Our client, Vertex, is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation. As they grow their pipeline at pace, they are strengthening their reputation for creating transformative medicines for people with serious diseases.

Position Summary

The Director, Regional Finance, will use their business acumen and enterprise leadership mindset to play an active part on the cross-functional country leadership team, with a focus on providing Finance partnering support.

This includes forecasting, performance management, accounting, and internal controls. The role is a key business partner to the Country Manager.

This position is based in Sao Paulo, Brazil, within the Southern Europe and Brazil regional organization. Build key relationships with Global CAO services and act as a liaison with our in-country outsourced providers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Accountable for the administrative, financial, and risk management operations of the affiliate, including the development of a financial and operational strategy, metrics tied to that strategy, and the ongoing development and monitoring of control systems designed to preserve company assets and report accurate financial results.
  • Provide financial leadership to the Brazil entity and drive partnership with local business leads.
  • Part of core deal team working to unlock reimbursement in the country, lead on all financial analysis in support of dossier creation, pricing decisions and reimbursement negotiations.
  • Drive the Brazil financial forecast and financial reporting processes.
  • Actively integrate the corporate planning activities with various business leaders.
  • Develop local goals supporting achievement the overall international goals.
  • Support local team in analysing and driving market KPIs.
  • Partner with local team in setting and controlling field incentive scheme.
  • Driving further finance and accounting input into the revenue forecast for the countries in scope.
  • Provide demand forecast for countries in scope and partner with Supply Chain to optimize stock levels and improve forecast accuracy.
  • Provide effective leadership facilitating collaboration among shared service transactional groups and local stakeholders.
  • Supporting finance and accounting transactional processes in countries such as record to report and source to settle, including forecasting, accruals and training to local teams.
  • Drive rigorous and transparent application of group policies and procedures throughout the countries in scope.
  • Reinforcing a robust internal control framework.
  • Work with international finance and corporate tax on all local tax filings.
  • Assist with statutory accounts filings across legal entity serviced.
  • Participate in external audit and other professional relationships.
  • Coordinate with Global CAO Services on the use of in country outsourced service providers.
  • Develop business cases for strategic investments.
  • Partner with legal to ensure completeness, accuracy and monitoring of contractual arrangements.
  • Participate in assessment and deployment of efficient systems, processes and operations.
  • Participating in global projects representing local needs.
  • Prepare briefing materials for senior management.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Advanced Degree in Accounting or Business administration.
  • Extensive experience in a major company or division of a large corporation, progressively responsible experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or health care industries performing financial planning, sales forecasting, business analytics, or consulting roles.
  • Experience conducting complex analytic assignments in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluency in English and Brazilian languages.
  • A solid understanding of financial valuation techniques as well as experience evaluating alternative investment opportunities and business strategies.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, able to navigate the corporate landscape, quickly establish credibility and build effective, collaborative, working relationships at all levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically, identify key issues and value drivers, and translate strategic insights into an appropriate analytic framework.
  • Ability to partner with other functional areas to develop, improve and monitor compliance with policies and procedures including taking a leadership role on certain initiatives.
  • A track record of proactively identifying problems and gaining consensus on potential solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Advanced knowledge and proficiency of MS Excel (including VBA Macros), MS PowerPoint and financial planning and reporting systems (Hyperion, OBIEE).

Vertex is partnering with Talent Works to manage their international temporary job openings. If you are successful in your application, you will be employed by Talent Works to work on a temporary assignment at Vertex.

title: Pre-Sales Engineer
description:
Job Title: Pre-Sales Engineer (LatAm)

Location: Remote (Based in/near São Paulo, Brazil)

Employment Type: Full-time, Long-term Independent Contractor

Remuneration: USD 1,500 – USD 3,000 / month (Gross, based on experience)

About Wayzim

Wayzim Technology Co., Ltd. () is a leading global provider of intelligent logistics automation solutions. We specialize in advanced sorting systems, conveyor technologies, and smart warehouse infrastructure, serving top e-commerce, express delivery, and 3PL leaders worldwide.

Position Overview

We are looking for a proactive, fast-learning Pre-Sales Engineer based in the São Paulo area to serve as a key technical bridge between our Latin America sales team, regional clients, and HQ mechanical design engineers in China.

In this role, you will lead client technical communications, develop CAD solution layouts, and participate in hands-on site visits across Latin America to help drive business expansion in the region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Solution Design & CAD Layouts: Collaborate closely with China-based mechanical engineers and local sales teams to translate client requirements into technical proposals and accurate 2D/3D CAD layouts.
  • Client Engagement: Join technical discussions, client meetings, and proposal presentations across Latin America to address technical inquiries and clarify scope.
  • On-Site Alignment & Training: Travel to project sites (in Brazil and other LatAm countries) for site surveys, dimensional verification, and hands-on training on Wayzim equipment.
  • Continuous Learning: Actively master Wayzim’s equipment specifications, mechanical structures, and automation workflows to independently drive regional pre-sales technical support.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics , or related engineering fields.
  • Work Experience: Up to 5 years of experience in pre-sales technical support, mechanical design, or project engineering (promising junior candidates are welcome).
  • Software Skills: Proficient in AutoCAD ; familiarity with 3D modeling software (e.g., SolidWorks) is a plus.
  • Language Skills:
  • English: Fluent (written & spoken, required for daily communication with headquarters).
  • Spanish: Conversational to fluent (strong advantage for regional project coverage).
  • Portuguese: Native or fluent.
  • Location & Mobility: Based in or near São Paulo, Brazil . Must hold a valid passport and be willing to travel internationally across Latin America for site visits and equipment training.
  • Key Traits: High self-motivation, strong independent learning capability, and excellent cross-cultural communication skills.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package ( USD 1,500 – USD 3,000 / month ).
  • Flexible remote work model with travel opportunities across Latin America.
  • Direct exposure to cutting-edge global logistics automation technology and large-scale industrial projects.

A posição terá atuação fortemente direcionada à negociação comercial com transportadoras, análise e tabulação de fretes, condução de concorrências, gestão de contratos e identificação de oportunidades de saving.

Buscamos uma pessoa com visão estratégica, capacidade analítica e forte habilidade de negociação. A oportunidade não possui foco exclusivamente operacional. Por isso, é indispensável ter experiência efetiva na frente comercial de Compras, Procurement ou Strategic Sourcing de fretes .

Principais atribuições

  • Conduzir processos estratégicos de compra de fretes e serviços de transporte;
  • Realizar cotações, concorrências, negociações, RFIs, RFQs e RFPs;
  • Analisar, tabular e equalizar propostas técnicas e comerciais de transportadoras;
  • Negociar preços, reajustes, prazos, condições comerciais, níveis de serviço e cláusulas contratuais;
  • Analisar tabelas de frete e os diferentes componentes envolvidos na formação dos custos de transporte;
  • Desenvolver estratégias de negociação com base em rotas, volumes, tipo de carga, quilometragem, tonelagem, cubagem e perfil de veículo;
  • Prospectar, desenvolver, homologar e gerir fornecedores de transporte;
  • Acompanhar tendências, movimentações, sazonalidades e mudanças no mercado de fretes;
  • Conduzir revisões periódicas da base de fornecedores e das condições comerciais contratadas;
  • Identificar e implementar oportunidades de redução de custos, geração de saving e cost avoidance;
  • Estruturar análises de spend e indicadores para apoiar negociações e decisões de compras;
  • Gerenciar contratos, SLAs e desempenho comercial dos fornecedores;
  • Avaliar riscos relacionados à capacidade operacional, cobertura geográfica, nível de serviço e sustentabilidade financeira dos parceiros;
  • Atuar em parceria com as áreas de Logística, Supply Chain, Manutenção, Financeiro e demais áreas envolvidas;
  • Apoiar a construção de estratégias para aumentar a eficiência e a competitividade da malha logística.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Logística, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência sólida em compras estratégicas, negociação ou sourcing de fretes e serviços de transporte;

  • Experiência com análise, tabulação e equalização de tabelas e propostas de frete;
  • Conhecimento sobre formação de custos de transporte e variáveis como rotas, quilometragem, tonelagem, cubagem, perfil de carga e tipo de veículo;
  • Experiência com gestão de contratos, fornecedores, indicadores e identificação de oportunidades de saving;

  • Excel em nível intermediário ou avançado para análise e tratamento de dados.

  • Vivência com categorias de alto spend e negociações de grande impacto financeiro;

  • Capacidade de interpretar atos societários, exigências, normas e procedimentos administrativos.
  • Experiência na condução simultânea de diferentes processos e clientes, com organização e controle rigoroso de prazos.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia, identificando o próximo passo necessário sem depender de direcionamento constante.
  • Forte senso de responsabilidade sobre as demandas assumidas, acompanhando cada processo até sua efetiva conclusão.

Esperamos que essa pessoa consiga receber um assunto, compreender o objetivo, estruturar as etapas necessárias, executar ou coordenar cada uma delas, acompanhar pendências e conduzir o processo até sua conclusão.

title: Coordenador de operações e processos
description:
Coordenador(a) de Operações e Processos

Sobre a vaga

A DermoSec está em um momento de crescimento e estruturação e busca um(a) Coordenador(a) de Operações e Processos para atuar diretamente com o CEO na gestão, organização e evolução da operação da empresa.

A pessoa será responsável por coordenar a rotina das principais áreas operacionais, acompanhar indicadores e metas, estruturar processos, desenvolver padrões de trabalho, identificar gargalos e garantir que as prioridades definidas pela liderança sejam efetivamente executadas.

Buscamos alguém com forte capacidade de gestão, organização, visão analítica, liderança e execução, capaz de transformar uma operação ainda muito dependente de pessoas e da atuação direta do CEO em uma empresa cada vez mais organizada, previsível, documentada e orientada por processos e indicadores.

A posição terá reporte direto ao CEO e será uma das principais interfaces entre a Diretoria e as diferentes áreas da empresa.

Objetivo da posição

Garantir que a operação da DermoSec funcione de forma integrada, eficiente e organizada, com processos claros, indicadores acompanhados, responsabilidades definidas e problemas tratados antes que impactem o negócio.

Um dos principais objetivos da função será reduzir progressivamente a dependência operacional da empresa em relação ao CEO, permitindo que a liderança concentre cada vez mais tempo em estratégia, crescimento, novos negócios, produtos e expansão.

Principais responsabilidades

Gestão da operação e das áreas

* Coordenar a rotina operacional das principais áreas da empresa;

* Acompanhar diretamente Financeiro/RH, Logística/Compras, Vendas, SAC e demais áreas operacionais;

* Realizar reuniões periódicas de acompanhamento com os responsáveis de cada área;

* Estruturar uma rotina de gestão semanal e mensal;

* Acompanhar prioridades, prazos, pendências, metas e entregas;

* Promover integração e comunicação eficiente entre as diferentes áreas;

* Garantir clareza sobre quem é responsável por cada atividade e decisão;

* Identificar riscos e problemas antes que cheguem à Diretoria;

* Atuar na resolução de conflitos, gargalos e dificuldades entre áreas;

* Garantir que decisões tomadas em reuniões sejam transformadas em ações, responsáveis e prazos;

* Cobrar execução e acompanhar os planos de ação até sua conclusão.

Gestão por indicadores e performance

* Definir, acompanhar e consolidar os principais KPIs de cada área;

* Desenvolver dashboards e relatórios executivos;

* Acompanhar metas e identificar desvios de performance;

* Conduzir reuniões de acompanhamento de resultados;

* Cobrar planos de ação para indicadores abaixo do esperado;

* Identificar tendências, riscos e oportunidades por meio dos dados;

* Garantir que cada responsável conheça e acompanhe seus indicadores;

* Preparar uma visão consolidada da operação para apresentação ao CEO.

Processos e organização

* Mapear todos os principais processos da empresa;

* Identificar processos inexistentes, informais ou excessivamente dependentes de conhecimento individual;

* Criar, documentar e implementar processos internos;

* Desenvolver SOPs, procedimentos operacionais, fluxos, checklists, manuais e políticas internas;

* Definir responsáveis, etapas, aprovações, prazos e indicadores para cada processo;

* Padronizar a maneira como as atividades são executadas;

* Reduzir retrabalho, erros, atrasos e dependência de conhecimento não documentado;

* Criar processos de onboarding para novos colaboradores;

* Garantir que os processos criados sejam efetivamente implementados e utilizados pela equipe;

* Revisar processos periodicamente e promover melhoria contínua;

* Identificar possibilidades de automação e ganho de eficiência.

Projetos e execução

* Coordenar projetos internos que envolvam múltiplas áreas;

* Criar cronogramas, responsáveis, prioridades e datas de entrega;

* Acompanhar projetos de novos produtos, fornecedores, sistemas, ferramentas e melhorias internas;

* Apoiar a coordenação operacional dos lançamentos de novos produtos;

* Garantir alinhamento entre áreas envolvidas em cada projeto;

* Antecipar riscos que possam comprometer prazos;

* Acompanhar projetos do início até a conclusão;

* Garantir que projetos estratégicos não parem por falta de acompanhamento.

Interface com o CEO

* Reportar-se diretamente ao CEO;

* Transformar as prioridades definidas pelo CEO em planos de execução;

* Preparar reuniões executivas com informações consolidadas;

* Levar à Diretoria apenas assuntos que realmente demandem decisão do CEO;

* Sempre que possível, apresentar problemas acompanhados de contexto, alternativas e recomendação;

* Proteger o tempo do CEO de demandas operacionais que possam ser resolvidas pela própria gestão;

* Garantir follow-up das decisões tomadas pela Diretoria;

* Manter o CEO informado sobre riscos relevantes, sem transferir desnecessariamente a gestão operacional para ele.

O comportamento esperado é:

“Identifiquei o problema, analisei as causas, alinhei com os responsáveis, estas são as alternativas e recomendo seguirmos por este caminho.”

E não:

“Temos um problema. O que devemos fazer?”

Gestão de pessoas

* Coordenar e desenvolver os responsáveis pelas áreas;

* Realizar reuniões individuais e de acompanhamento;

* Definir expectativas e responsabilidades claras;

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
This is a fully remote position based in Brazil. You will be engaged as an independent contractor.

Salary: USD $900/month plus performance-based quarterly bonus of up to $400. Includes paid time off, parental leave, and health insurance.

Company Overview

Jones is a vertical AI company that helps real estate and construction firms make smarter decisions about insurance so they can boost efficiency and mitigate risk. Across more than 2.5 billion square feet of real estate and construction projects, Jones enables clients to leverage AI, software, and data to accelerate and strengthen insurance verification, collection, integration, and decision-making across commercial and residential asset classes.

Jones has experienced rapid growth driven by the urgent need to modernize the outdated risk and compliance workflows in real estate and construction. In this position, you’ll be sitting at the heart of our operations team and play a direct role in delivering on our core product promise.

Position Overview

We’re looking for auditors of Certificates of Insurance. No previous knowledge needed, full training will be provided. As the key part of your responsibilities, you'll review certificates submitted by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors, confirm that required coverages are in place, and flag gaps before they become problems for our customers. Success here demands precision, a methodical approach, and the ability to stay consistent under volume. If that sounds like you, we'd love to connect.

Please note that this is a dedicated, full-time position requiring your undivided professional focus; it is not compatible with concurrent employment or part-time arrangements.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We use focused assessments to evaluate fit. If you're detail-oriented and eager to grow, we encourage you to apply.

What You’ll Do

  • Review Certificates of Insurance (COIs) and supporting documents, verifying that coverage meets each client's specific requirements;
  • Accurately input compliance data into our system and flag any gaps or missing coverage for resolution;
  • Follow internal processes and guidelines to ensure best practices are upheld;
  • Collaborate actively with the team to support shared goals and maintain workflow continuity.

Who You Are

  • A clear, professional communicator in English, with strong written and verbal skills for cross-team collaboration.
  • Available 40 hours per week during U.S. business hours (EST).
  • Consistently accurate, with a track record of meeting quality targets.
  • Coachable and growth-minded: you respond well to feedback, document your learnings, and apply improvements quickly.
  • Comfortable following structured workflows and confident enough to escalate when something doesn't add up.
  • Self-motivated and persistent: you work well independently without needing close oversight.
  • Background in insurance, data entry, quality assurance, or any structured, process-driven role is a plus.

Why Join Jones

  • Become an expert in an area of real estate/construction operations and insurance that is undergoing serious digital transformation
  • Join an award-winning company tracking best-in-class SaaS growth month-over-month.
  • Fair compensation with performance-based raises and bonuses;
  • Learn directly from talented, experienced leaders who are invested in your growth.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, multicultural startup environment.
  • Be part of a lean, agile team with a strong culture and a big vision.
  • Help Jones execute on a massive vision to build a network for risk & compliance transactions in the built world
  • Develop a strong understanding of SaaS operations fundamentals and skills needed to grow in a start-up company.

Our culture

Our goal is to build a company where people feel ownership of their role and are able to grow and enrich their skills and experience. We also want to create an environment where people are challenged and encouraged to be entrepreneurial. We rely on our team to help identify and take action on initiatives that can move our business forward. Elements of our culture that can be seen in every one of our people are the following:

  • Fall in love with problems – We are obsessed with solving customer problems because it’s in our DNA — actively listening to customer challenges and treating them like our own.
  • Give help generously – We hire and nurture brilliant people who are generous with their time, skills, and perspectives. This generosity compounds across the company.
  • Own the outcome – Every day we make vital decisions that shape the future of our company. We hold ourselves accountable to these decisions in order to build a durable, powerful business.
  • Take care of yourself – Building a category-leading company is hard. It can only be achieved by encouraging and enabling our team’s mental, emotional, and physical well-being.
  • Build trust everywhere – Every Jones experience is designed to give our clients, our team, and our industry unshakable confidence in the integrity of the company.

title: Professor(a) Especialista - Ensino Fundamental Anos Finais
description:
A Maple Bear Jacareí busca Professores(as) Especialistas para integrar nossa equipe acadêmica e atuar nos Anos Finais do Ensino Fundamental.

O(a) profissional será responsável pelo planejamento e condução das aulas em seu componente curricular, promovendo experiências de aprendizagem significativas, desafiadoras e adequadas à faixa etária dos estudantes, em alinhamento com a proposta pedagógica e bilíngue da Maple Bear.

Entre as principais responsabilidades estão o planejamento e preparação das aulas, elaboração e aplicação de atividades e avaliações, acompanhamento do desenvolvimento e desempenho acadêmico dos estudantes, realização dos registros pedagógicos e participação nos processos de acompanhamento da aprendizagem.

O(a) professor(a) atuará em parceria com a Coordenação Pedagógica e demais docentes, participando de reuniões pedagógicas, projetos interdisciplinares, eventos e outras iniciativas acadêmicas relacionadas ao segmento e à sua área de atuação.

Buscamos profissionais que valorizem uma educação ativa, estimulando a autonomia, o pensamento crítico, a investigação e o protagonismo dos estudantes, e que desejem contribuir para o desenvolvimento e consolidação dos Anos Finais na unidade.

A atuação será presencial em Jacareí/SP.

Qualificações

  • Formação superior em Licenciatura compatível com o componente curricular de atuação;
  • Domínio dos conhecimentos específicos de sua área e dos conteúdos relacionados aos Anos Finais do Ensino Fundamental;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente, com capacidade para conduzir aulas e interagir academicamente com os estudantes em língua inglesa — requisito obrigatório para os componentes ministrados em inglês;
  • Para candidatos à área de Matemática, o domínio da língua inglesa não será requisito obrigatório;
  • Capacidade de planejamento, elaboração de atividades, avaliações e estratégias de aprendizagem;
  • Habilidade para acompanhar e avaliar o desenvolvimento acadêmico dos estudantes;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de relacionamento com estudantes, famílias e equipe pedagógica;
  • Perfil responsável, colaborativo, organizado e comprometido com a aprendizagem;
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ativas, tecnologias educacionais e práticas pedagógicas contemporâneas;
  • Experiência nos Anos Finais do Ensino Fundamental será considerada um diferencial;
  • Experiência em educação bilíngue ou internacional será considerada um diferencial.

title: Estágio em Audiovisual | Videomaker
description:
A Hike Capital é uma gestora de patrimônio que atende famílias e investidores, utilizando como base o modelo fee-based e relacionamento próximo com o cliente.

Sobre a Área

O time de marketing da Hike Capital é responsável por transformar a estratégia de comunicação da gestora em conteúdo relevante para redes sociais, mantendo a identidade da marca e o tom institucional que o público exige.

Sobre a Vaga

Buscamos uma pessoa criativa e organizada para captar e editar vídeos para Instagram, TikTok e YouTube. Você será responsável por todo o processo de criação de conteúdo audiovisual, da captação à entrega final, trabalhando lado a lado com o time de marketing. Mais do que dominar ferramentas de edição, buscamos alguém com repertório para reconhecer bons formatos e adaptar linguagem de tendências digitais a um público de maior patrimônio, sem perder a seriedade que a marca exige.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Captar vídeos em gravações, eventos e conteúdos internos da Hike
  • Editar vídeos para Instagram, TikTok, Stories, Reels e YouTube
  • Adaptar conteúdos para diferentes formatos e plataformas
  • Aplicar motion design em peças de vídeo quando necessário
  • Organizar arquivos e materiais audiovisuais da área
  • Acompanhar tendências de edição, narrativa e ritmo nas redes sociais e propor testes de novos formatos
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de marketing no planejamento de conteúdo

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Cursando Publicidade, Audiovisual, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com captação e edição de vídeo para redes sociais
  • Domínio de ferramentas de edição, como Premiere Pro, CapCut ou similares
  • Bom entendimento das linguagens de Instagram, TikTok e YouTube
  • Agilidade para editar e entregar conteúdos em prazos curtos

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com motion design (After Effects ou similar)
  • Repertório atualizado sobre tendências de formato e ritmo de edição
  • Interesse por mercado financeiro e investimentos

title: VENDEDOR EXTERNO - SUMARÉ/SP

  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Vendor Manager
description:
About Appen:

Appen is a global market leader in data for the AI Lifecycle. With 30 years of experience in data sourcing, data annotation, and model evaluation by humans, we enable organizations to launch the world’s most innovative artificial intelligence systems.

Our expertise includes a global crowd of more than 1 million skilled contractors who speak over 500 languages, in over 200 countries, as well as our advanced AI data platform. Our products and services give leaders in technology, automotive, financial services, retail, healthcare, and governments the confidence to launch world-class AI products. Founded in 1996, Appen has customers and offices globally.

Responsibilities:

  • Overall responsible for the expansion and operation of Appen (BPO resources).
  • Develop long-term and short-term resource procurement strategies based on local and regional data service business needs and market trends (data annotation/collection/translation/on-site services, etc.), including BPO vendor selection, contract management, cost control, etc.
  • BPO Management: To drive the expansion, evaluation, negotiation, and relationship maintenance of BPO vendor in local and adjacent regions, ensuring compliance with the company’s admission standards.
  • Collect and analyze data, and regularly report resource sourcing progress (including achievements and risks) to the Leader, providing support for decision-making.
  • Assist Leaders in Brazil/China for new office selection, new office establishment, contract signing, construction, routine procurement, and other related tasks.
  • Cross-departmental collaboration: Work closely with horizontal functions such as Project Management, Legal, and Finance to ensure smooth business operations.

Requirements:

  • CV is required to submit by English.
  • Native Portuguese speaker; business-level proficiency in Spanish and English.
  • Bachelor’s degree or above.
  • At least 3 or 4 years of relevant work experience, familiar with the data services industry; experience as a Vendor/procurement manager for data collection and annotation, or in a related role such as Industrial Automation, Smart Manufacturing.
  • Candidates with experience in setting-up new offices are preferred.
  • Strong presentation skills, excellent communication, and outstanding negotiation abilities.
  • Ability to work under pressure and effectively handle various unexpected situations.

title: Estágio Editorial

Estamos com uma nova oportunidade na Editora Aleph!

Essa vaga tem como objetivo inclusão de jovens pretos e pardos

title: Analista Administrativo Financeiro
description:
Descrição da vaga

Organização sem fins lucrativos sediada em Campinas busca profissional para atuar na área administrativo-financeira, em uma estrutura enxuta e com contato próximo com a gestão.

Buscamos uma pessoa que vá além da execução das rotinas financeiras. O profissional deverá ter capacidade analítica, raciocínio lógico, domínio avançado de planilhas e autonomia para transformar dados financeiros em informações úteis para a tomada de decisão.

A posição envolve atividades variadas. Mais importante do que ter experiência prévia em todas elas será demonstrar capacidade para compreender problemas, pesquisar soluções, organizar processos e conduzir as demandas com segurança e proatividade.

Horário e Remuneração

CLT 40 horas semanais / dois dias remoto e três dias presencial / Salário base de 4.135,00 / Unimed / Vale Refeição / Totalpass.

Principais Responsabilidades*

• Acompanhar a execução orçamentária, analisando realizado versus planejado e identificando desvios relevantes;

• Preparar relatórios e informações financeiras para apoio à gestão e à Diretoria;

• Elaborar projeções, controles e análises financeiras;

• Acompanhar fluxo de caixa, contas a pagar, recebimentos e aplicações financeiras;

• Organizar centros de custos e apoiar a alocação e o controle de recursos;

• Manter e aprimorar controles e planilhas gerenciais;

• Apoiar processos relacionados a compras, contratos, documentação e rotinas administrativas;

• Dar suporte às rotinas de pessoal, benefícios, férias e demais controles administrativos;

• Interagir com contabilidade, bancos, fornecedores e demais parceiros;

• Identificar necessidades de melhoria nos controles e processos da área e propor soluções..

O que buscamos

• Formação superior em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia, Finanças ou áreas correlatas;

• Experiência em atividades administrativas e financeiras;

• Excel ou outra ferramenta de planilhas em nível avançado;

• Boa capacidade de análise quantitativa e raciocínio lógico-matemático;

• Capacidade de estruturar relatórios e apresentar informações financeiras de maneira clara;

title: Space Control & Transshipment Analyst
description:
Main responsibilities and assignments:

  • Connection Planning & Management:

- Review, plan and coordinate vessel connection schedules with Space Control (SPC) to ensure timely transshipment execution and prevent operational complications.

- Monitor regional ports to guarantee compliance with connection standards, taking into account cargo priorities and port capacity.

- Evaluate and propose strategies to mitigate risks and reduce dwell time at transshipment ports.

  • Operational Monitoring & Coordination:

- Provide consolidated operational reports, identifying critical ports or regional trends that require special attention.

- Share transshipment projections with Marketing/Pricing team to monitor cargo trends across different ports

- Monitor cargo flow (TS) volumes in all LAM ports

- Coordinate with Local offices to implement necessary cargo adjustments (in case of overbookings, move count restrictions or other operational restrictions).

  • Booking Validation & Routing:

- Verify routing logic for bookings

- Control and manage bottlenecks to proactively advise on potential delays or service capacity increases

- Analyze and coordinate with SPC recovery plan for vessels, including necessary adjustments like skip ports or additional cargo discharge.

  • KPI & Regulatory Compliance:

- Measure and report the cargo dwell time across LAM ports and status of any existing operational backlog

- Alert Procurement team related issues generating additional costs from terminal or carrier sources

- Maintain updated knowledge of LAM port regulations to ensure full compliance and avoid penalties or issues impacting the client experience.

  • Regular meetings: with Global Office, Regional Offices (other regions) and LAM countries to align Transshipment strategy.

Degree and specific knowledge:

  • Completed Bachelor's degree (Business Adm/International Trade or similar)
  • Advanced English - essential for seamless communication with Global Office
  • Intermediate Spanish - to interact within Latin America Countries
  • Previous experience with shipping or freight forwarder, ideally dealing with ship space, bookings, logistics or operations
  • Google Sheets and KPI management

Ocean Network Express (ONE) was incepted on July 7, 2017, following the liner service integrations of Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha (“K” LINE), Mitsui O.S.K. Lines (MOL) and Nippon Yusen Kaisha (NYK).
